programme.title: 鄖縣人3號
programme.desc: 《“鄖縣人”3號》共三集，分別為《啟封》、《領隊》、《遠方》，聚焦于東方人類起源演化的重大里程碑成果，用伴隨式的鏡頭，從考古發掘工作與“考古人”兩條脈絡出發，全景式記錄“鄖縣人”3號頭骨發掘、提取工作，借助對考古隊生活化情境和細節描摹，傳播考古人的文化傳承精神，詮釋中國人的文明源流與精神底色。在古今“鄖縣人”跨越百萬年的時空對話中，探索人類起源之路，追尋過去的歷史，也不斷思索未來，叩問全人類發展的方向。本片由<湖北廣播電視台>贈播。

programme.title: 唐頓莊園 第五季
programme.desc: 第五季的劇情主要圍繞著唐頓莊園面臨的時代挑戰展開，貴族和僕人之間的生活繼續交織，展現了家族內部的愛恨情仇和秘密，以及在外來文化衝擊下莊園的新挑戰。瑪麗在喪夫後努力保護莊園，並尋找新的生活，她的愛情故事也跌宕起伏，為劇情增添了緊張感。同時，伊蒂絲和德魯的關係面臨危機，安娜和貝茨的故事線也引人入勝。

programme.title: 青春有歌
programme.desc: 節目每集設置一個音樂主題，邀請經典校園歌曲音樂人、新聲代校園歌手與主持人一起“唱”、“談”八十、九十年代流行的校園歌曲及校園民謠，欣賞新時代優秀原創校園歌曲作品，分享歌曲創作演出經歷和音樂背後的故事。

programme.title: 好劇連場: 點心之路
好劇連場: 心靈法醫
programme.desc: 《心靈法醫》由聶遠、宋軼主演。該劇根據法醫朱明川的小說《聽屍》改編。明川，鵬海市警隊法醫，技術出眾，天賦異稟。當明川 站在屍檢台前，他就成了鵬海市遠近聞名的“聽屍者”。憑著微小的線索就能找出真相，破獲了一宗宗離奇的案件。但除了探尋真相之外，他還關心一些與法醫無關的事情——死者的遺願，生者的遺憾。對活人的疏離和對死人的溫暖，讓明川成為一個神秘的存在。沒有人能了解他的過去，也沒有人能預測他的將來。適時，鵬海市發生一連環殺人案，兇手在短短幾年的時間裡接連殺了多個人，每次都會將被害人開膛破肚。這些案件作案手法十分獨特，警方判斷兇手曾受過醫學專業的訓練，稱之為“殺人醫生”。“殺人醫生”案吸引了初來乍到的刑警女隊長羅筆芯的注意，她將目光鎖定到神秘的明川身上，並開始在工作和生活中關注明川。

programme.title: 越戰越勇
programme.desc: 《越戰越勇》為有著歌唱夢想的觀眾開放，關注他們“築夢、追夢、圓夢”的心路歷程，主打“真人、真故事”，所有創作皆以真實為核心。每個登場選手沒有任何劇本，他們只需做到“盡情歌唱”和“實話實說”。每期有6位來自全國各地、各行各業的參賽者登上舞台，通過演唱環節及點評投票對決環節，增加節目的刺激性。

programme.title: 趨記茶餐廳
programme.desc: 一部以澳門茶餐廳為背景的輕鬆幽默連續劇，故事圍繞茶餐廳的日常營運展開，當中穿插生活熱話，搞笑得來又有共鳴，歡迎大家光臨！

programme.title: 乘風踏浪
programme.desc:
《乘風踏浪》由喬杉、楊子姍領銜主演的時代創業喜劇。該劇講述了以彭錦西和羅虹夫婦為代表的興城泳裝人乘著改革東風成功創業的故事，通過兩個小人物從解決溫飽到成為萬元戶，再到成為當地企業家代表的歷程，將時代發展浪潮的關鍵節點一一還原，以小見大地展現出改革開放的變遷史。
1978年，20歲的遼寧興城人彭錦西（喬杉飾）被情敵秦升舉報“投機倒把”入獄，失去了上大學的資格。彭錦西出獄後自產自銷做起泳褲生意，女友羅虹（楊子姍飾）不離不棄，他們克服重重困難喜結連理，彭錦西成為當地第一個“萬元戶”。1980年代初，政策放開，遠親賈為民等人效仿彭錦西建作坊做泳裝，開始與他展開價格戰，彭錦西夫婦見招拆招，既鞏固了本地市場，又團結了同行，讓“興城泳裝”走向全國。1990年代，彭錦西遭遇秦升復仇和市場整改的雙面夾擊，跌入低谷，他依舊樂觀，憑藉過人的智慧，幾經沉浮找到突破口，建立正規工廠和自主品牌，成功突圍。之後，夫婦二帶領“興城泳裝”乘風踏浪，成為全球最大的泳裝生產基地。

programme.title: 歸去來兮 - 兩岸百年黃埔記憶
電影: 愛情良餐
programme.desc: 莉亞堅持自己做所有事情，努力擴大她的非營利送餐服務，在伊萊的幫助下，她發現生意就像浪漫一樣，只要付出一點努力和信任就可以綻放。

programme.title: 《葡角漫遊》之佛得角
programme.desc: 澳門一直與葡萄牙及其他葡語系國家保持著良好的關係，隨著澳廣視轄下澳門 - Macau衛星頻道落地到葡語國家，觀眾範圍不斷擴大，彼此交流更加方便。澳廣視主持人布廷欣早前到訪葡語系國家葡萄牙及佛得角。一連三集的《葡角漫遊》之佛得角，分別會帶大家快閃葡萄牙，一嘗當地美食; 去到佛得角首都普拉亞，了解中國在當地的援助項目;還會去到佛得角其中兩個擁有美麗海洋資源的島嶼，感受不一樣的非洲風情。

programme.title: The World's Most Secret Hotels 1
programme.desc: In Jordan we find out what it's like to stay deep in the desert sleeping underneath the stars at the Bubble Luxotel Wadi Rum resort - a remote and unusual series of transparent "bubble" tents which look more like a cluster of space craft on Mars. programme.title: Junior Bake Off 11
programme.desc: The bakers face their last chance to earn a crust in Finals Week with self pie‑traits.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is thrilled when she’s chosen to build the mascot snowman –or in her case, snowlady – for the annual Maywood winter festival. programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Olivia’s Mom gets sick, Olivia steps into her shoes and helps plan a tea party. And not just any old tea party – this is a pirate tea party! It’s not quite what the client had in mind, but in the end they have to admit: there’s never been a tea party as much fun as Olivia’s!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is disappointed when she hurts her leg on the eve of her big tap dance recital. But the show must go on! Taking inspiration from her baby brother William’s rolling walker, she builds herself a fanciful apparatus – the tip top tapper – so that she can dance as scheduled. Thanks to her new invention, her performance is a hit!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Invasion of the Bog Monsters ‐ Casper has built a special whistle to attract bats, but when he tries to test the whistle, Bog Monsters from all over the Forbidden Forest are attracted to Scare School by its sound. When Professor Burns accidentally swallows the whistle after having confiscated it from Casper, The Bog Monsters start invading the school and create a huge mess by turning everyone they touch into bog‐monsters too. Even Mantha is turned into a Bog Monster! Casper, with Ra’s help, must retrieve the whistle and turn his fellow students and professors back to normal! Now you see me, Now you don’t ‐ Casper is messing about in class and making fun of Ra in class by turning invisible. Frankengymteacher gives him detention, along with Ra and Mantha. Casper’s friends are FURIOUS! They’ve got detention because of HIM!! Trying to solve the problem he’s got them all in to Casper makes FGT believe that he too can become invisible. The teacher takes the bate, totally believing that by doing a silly dance and singing a preposterous song he really IS invisible.. FGT tries playing tricks on everybody truly thinking all the time that they can’t see him. When Alder and Dash get wind of FGT’s antics they decide he’s insane and he’s promptly suspended! Casper must do everything he can to fix the mess he’s made and help FGT get his job back.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Love Potion ‐ The little monsters are in ‘POTION CLASS’, concocting new and untried potions with professor Burns. Casper accidently tries to brighten things up and ends up with a bright pink potion that put the fear into Prof Burns. Oh NO! Casper’s made LOVE POTION, A dreaded, lovely, sweet thing that has no place in Scare School. Casper’s told to get rid of it, and throws it away in the Forbidden Forest. But three little dragons drink the potion and turn into pink kissing machines, turning anyone they touch into the same ridiculous chilled out friendly monsters as them. Panic in scare school! The Headmasters are furious and start organising a major hunt for the dragons – until of course but Alder & Dash also turn pink too.. All is almost lost ‐ Casper really must do something: it’s OK to have ONE friendly monster but EVERYONE? It’s just NOT Scare School! Stage Fright ‐ The Scare School students are getting ready to stage a play, but there’s a problem: Dummy Girl has disappeared! Woodward, the figurehead on Cappy’s pirate ship, is chosen to replace her. Unfortunately he really is a ‘wooden’ actor, and it’s a total disaster. The audience, who was supposed to be frightened, starts laughing. What a catastrophe for the kids of Scare School! What will the parents think? Will they take their kids out of school? How will Casper and his friends make it through? The answer is in this very special episode in which you can watch the play in real time!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries
programme.desc: When Marcus leaves for sleep-away camp, Phoebe discovers that being a “family fairy” means helping everyone in your assigned family, not just the children. / When Tracy hires Cassie to babysit Nicholas, and Eden asks Athena and Phoebe to lend a helping hand, Cassie and the Dews must find a way to get Nicholas to bed without his missing and beloved penguin stuffy.

programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. / When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. / When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia finds the perfect birthday present for Francine in a box of cereal – a pink charm bracelet! But when it accidentally falls down the drain, Olivia has to scramble to find an alternative: using trinkets that recall some of their favorite memories together, Olivia makes her own charm bracelet for a delighted Francine.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is thrilled when she’s chosen to build the mascot snowman –or in her case, snowlady – for the annual Maywood winter festival. She’s determined to build the biggest snowman anybody’s ever seen! But when all the snow melts away, Olivia has to build her snowlady out of something else: cotton candy!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Olivia’s Mom gets sick, Olivia steps into her shoes and helps plan a tea party. And not just any old tea party – this is a pirate tea party! It’s not quite what the client had in mind, but in the end they have to admit: there’s never been a tea party as much fun as Olivia’s!

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Olivia is disappointed when she hurts her leg on the eve of her big tap dance recital. But the show must go on! Taking inspiration from her baby brother William’s rolling walker, she builds herself a fanciful apparatus – the tip top tapper – so that she can dance as scheduled. Thanks to her new invention, her performance is a hit!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Invasion of the Bog Monsters ‐ Casper has built a special whistle to attract bats, but when he tries to test the whistle, Bog Monsters from all over the Forbidden Forest are attracted to Scare School by its sound. When Professor Burns accidentally swallows the whistle after having confiscated it from Casper, The Bog Monsters start invading the school and create a huge mess by turning everyone they touch into bog‐monsters too. Even Mantha is turned into a Bog Monster! Casper, with Ra’s help, must retrieve the whistle and turn his fellow students and professors back to normal! Now you see me, Now you don’t ‐ Casper is messing about in class and making fun of Ra in class by turning invisible. Frankengymteacher gives him detention, along with Ra and Mantha. Casper’s friends are FURIOUS! They’ve got detention because of HIM!! Trying to solve the problem he’s got them all in to Casper makes FGT believe that he too can become invisible. The teacher takes the bate, totally believing that by doing a silly dance and singing a preposterous song he really IS invisible.. FGT tries playing tricks on everybody truly thinking all the time that they can’t see him. When Alder and Dash get wind of FGT’s antics they decide he’s insane and he’s promptly suspended! Casper must do everything he can to fix the mess he’s made and help FGT get his job back.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Love Potion ‐ The little monsters are in ‘POTION CLASS’, concocting new and untried potions with professor Burns. Casper accidently tries to brighten things up and ends up with a bright pink potion that put the fear into Prof Burns. Oh NO! Casper’s made LOVE POTION, A dreaded, lovely, sweet thing that has no place in Scare School. Casper’s told to get rid of it, and throws it away in the Forbidden Forest. But three little dragons drink the potion and turn into pink kissing machines, turning anyone they touch into the same ridiculous chilled out friendly monsters as them. Panic in scare school! The Headmasters are furious and start organising a major hunt for the dragons – until of course but Alder & Dash also turn pink too.. All is almost lost ‐ Casper really must do something: it’s OK to have ONE friendly monster but EVERYONE? It’s just NOT Scare School! Stage Fright ‐ The Scare School students are getting ready to stage a play, but there’s a problem: Dummy Girl has disappeared! Woodward, the figurehead on Cappy’s pirate ship, is chosen to replace her. Unfortunately he really is a ‘wooden’ actor, and it’s a total disaster. The audience, who was supposed to be frightened, starts laughing. What a catastrophe for the kids of Scare School! What will the parents think? Will they take their kids out of school? How will Casper and his friends make it through? The answer is in this very special episode in which you can watch the play in real time!

programme.title: The Ice Rink Murders
programme.desc: After time away from the ice, elite figure skater Megan returns to training, only to find that a killer targeting skaters is giving a whole new meaning to the phrase "cut-throat competition."

programme.title: While They Were Sleeping
programme.desc: When Zoe wakes up to find her husband murdered beside her in bed, with no memory of anyone entering their home, she becomes the prime suspect. Inspired by actual events.
